description: This Java source file defines a MemoryAppender class for logging purposes, which stores recent log events in a configurable buffer. It includes methods for appending log events, retrieving stored log lines, and configuring the appender. The class is part of the org.openmrs.logging package and leverages Log4j 2 API for logging functionalities.

classes.name: MemoryAppender
classes.description: A custom Log4j 2 appender that stores a fixed number of recent log events in a buffer for retrieval, supporting dynamic configuration and garbage collection.

classes.name: MemoryAppender.MemoryAppenderBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing configured instances of MemoryAppender with customizable buffer size and layout.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a new log event to the buffer.

methods.name: getLogLines
methods.description: Retrieves the stored log events as a list of strings after converting them with the configured layout.

methods.name: createAppender
methods.description: Factory method for creating or retrieving an instance of MemoryAppender with specified configuration parameters.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the current size of the log event buffer.
